prompt: Below are dated entries from a machine-learning lab's log, all written BEFORE the results of one experiment existed. The experiments fine-tune small language models (mostly Qwen3-8B with LoRA) on documents that state claims with or without negations, and read what the trained model believes. ## 2026-10-06T08:01:00Z — kernels 239 and 240 (the "is also" pair) pre-registered after 239's design review: the distance control on both splits 239 (fm-listalso1-239, split A) and 240 (fm-listalsoswap-240, split B) train "Martin is also:" lists, with " also" where 227 and 225 have " not". Rows, order and LoRA initialisation (seed 0) are otherwise those of 218/227 and 226/225. Readouts 4f9f6612: be09c10d plus "is also:" document rows. The review confirmed: - 1,920 single-token insertions per corpus; web rows byte-identical; steps identical. - Every probe is at equal token distance from 227's and 239's training text. - The runner is unchanged. 240 is 239's corpus with --swap. It matches 225's items text for text except the header word (1,920 of 2,318). Why both splits (review): the negated twin's chat " is" deficit is 3.42 on split A but 0.91 on split B, and the untrained crossed term on split A is -2.36. One split mixes transfer with prior retention, so the stop's consequence (the pooled ratio) needs the pooled statistic. 237 showed the split gap is not initialisation noise on split A. Statistic (SPAR listsread_also.py, mock-tested: stand-ins give F 0 and 1): - Per header, the paired 2x2 term (listsread_pairs.py). - F = (d_is - d_also) / (d_is - d_isnot) on chat " is" (3.68, 1.52; denominator 2.16), with a 95% bootstrap over traits. Manipulation check (gates the decision): the "is also" pair's own-format term (generic "is also:") >= 7.3, the "is not" pair's 8.53 less 1.2. Decision: - F <= 0.3 (d_also >= 3.03): not explained by one inserted token. That rules out any single inserted word, not other meaning-changing words. - F >= 0.7 (d_also <= 2.17): distance. - Otherwise mixed. - d_also above d_is by more than 0.39 (237's header-contrast threshold): " also" is not neutral, and no reading is made. Reported beside it: - " is" (5.00/2.24), document "is:" (9.86/4.39) and " is not". - Each pair's share, chat over own format ("is" 0.37, "is not" 0.18). - Split A alone (239 against 218 and 227), as secondary. Prediction: F <= 0.3. Kernel 228 shows the model reads the negation in context. Kernel 219 lost 0.42 nats (11%) of the chat term, but it is not a clean distance analogue: 384 of its 1,920 profiles kept " is:". Post-run checks: untrained rows equal 218's on the 1,820 shared rows; update-0 and per-update NLL against 227 and 225 (same loss-token counts per update), since " also" may be more predictable than " not" after the bio. Stops the line if: the manipulation check is met and F >= 0.7 on chat " is" (d_also <= 2.17). One affirmative word in the negation's place then costs most of what "not" costs, and the header twins' chat ratio measures distance from the probe, not negation. The 2x2's 0.41 is not reported as a negation effect, and every negated form gets an "also" twin before any chat comparison. Launch: 239 now, into 237's slot. 240 after its own review, into 238's slot. 233's REVIEWED now holds its re-frozen hash (the review found only the readouts changed). ## 2026-10-06T08:19:00Z — kernel 240 reviewed; amendment to the 239/240 pre-registration before either is read 240's review found it exactly 239 on the complement split: - Its 1,920 profile rows differ from 225's only in " is not:" -> " is also:" (one token each), with equal per-update loss-token counts. - Web rows and steps are identical. - The reader pairs 239 with 240 with correct owners and sign. Mock runs give F 0, 1 and the band edges as intended. Amendments (from the review, before any "is also" data): - F is read only if 238's stop does not fire and its verdict is "reproduces". F's denominator uses 225's split-B level; at |D| = 1.0 the whole 0.3-0.7 band would sit within about 1 SD. The reader now checks results/noise_fm-listnotswapseed1-238.json. - Split-A F is printed but uninterpretable. The trained association's alignment differs by header, so it spans 0-0.37 under pure negation and 0.63-1.0 under pure distance. - The shares (chat over own format) are read beside F. Own-format terms of 7.3-8.1 would put pure negation in the "mixed" band. - Wording: F <= 0.3 rules out " also" as a distance cost, not any inserted word. An affirmative lift from " also" could offset a distance cost, and only d_also > d_is + 0.39 is flagged. - Before any stop verdict, the untrained model reads "is also:" lists in context (228's design, a third header), in kernel 241. A stop could otherwise reflect what " also" means rather than distance. 240 launches into the next free slot after kernel 241 (in-context reading of the 2x2 adapters; next entry). Task. The paired documents list claims under the header “Martin is also:” instead of “Martin is not:”; rows and order otherwise follow their respective paired runs, and 240 swaps the item assignment to match its split’s comparison corpus.
